exposure: sEMG characteristics of pelvic floor muscles
outcome: surface electromyography (sEMG) characteristics of pelvic floor muscles (PFM)
cohort: 478 women who visited Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital for postpartum re-examination between January and March 2023 were divided into groups with and without diastasis recti abdominis.
finding: Older maternal age, lower educational attainment, and higher parity were significantly associated with an increased risk of diastasis recti abdominis in early postpartum, and no correlation was found between sEMG characteristics of pelvic floor muscles and DRA.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found between the DRA and non-DRA groups in terms of delivery mode.
birth_weight: Fetal weight was measured and found to be lower in the non-DRA group compared to the DRA group.
